entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: Conflict that ravaged the surface of Corondor.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Planeswalker who destroyed Carth and fought Dakkon.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Planeswalker summoned by the Son of Carth, later bound by Geyadrone.

entities.name: Son of Carth
entities.description: Orphan of Carth who summoned Dakkon.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Elder Dragon servant of Geyadrone killed by Dakkon.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: Planeswalker who protected the children of southern Corondor.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: Formed by the explosion of Piru's death.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Land where Dakkon and the boy went.

events.summary: Geyadrone Dihada destroyed Carth, starting the war.
events.quote: beginning after the destruction of the city of Carth by the planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada

events.summary: Geyadrone tricked the Son of Carth into summoning Dakkon Blackblade.
events.quote: was tricked by Geyadrone herself to summon the planeswalker Dakkon Blackblade

events.summary: Dakkon killed Piru; the explosion created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
events.quote: the resulting explosion caused the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor

events.summary: Geyadrone absorbed Piru's power and bound Dakkon to her will.
events.quote: who managed to subdue Dakkon and bound him to her will

events.summary: Dakkon and the Lion of Carth decided to start anew in Terisiare.
events.quote: decided to start anew in the far land of Terisiare

relations.quote: When Dakkon killed Geyadrone's servant, the Elder Dragon Piru
